title: Throttle delay when moving off
summary: This topic combines one clearly negative complaint about delivery delay with undetermined mentions of a small throttle response delay when moving off at junctions.

negative.summary: The negative feedback is about continued delay in receiving the vehicle rather than throttle response.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention a notable or small delay before the throttle responds when moving off at junctions, but the limited examples do not confirm an overall sentiment classification.

limitations: The sample is very small and includes both delivery timing and throttle response, so the topic is not fully coherent.
Most examples are undetermined, which limits confidence in summarizing customer sentiment about the throttle delay.
